dedupe_keys.name: trajectory data and road network data

description: trajectory data and road network data is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Minshi LIU. We propose trajectory compression mode constrained by network. There are some data to reproduce our research. The trajectory data is Beijing taxi trajectory from Microsoft Research Asia, and the road network data is Beijing road network from OpenStreetMap. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1389206 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
